about.title: About {{app}}
about.lead: {{app}} is a free guide to help in Northern Virginia: food, benefits, health, housing, legal help and more, with live updates posted by the providers themselves.
about.what: We collect information about food pantries, free meals, delivery programs, and related help from public sources and from the organizations themselves. A person reviews each listing before it is published. We show what is confirmed, and we clearly say when something is not.
about.sourcesIntro: These are the sources we currently use:
about.labelVerified: A reviewer confirmed the listing in the last {{days}} days.
about.labelStale: The listing has not been confirmed recently. Details may be out of date.
about.labelSynthetic: Fictional test data used to check the site. It is not a real place.
about.review: We aim to re-check every listing at least every {{days}} days. Listings that have not been re-checked are marked “Needs re-check”.
about.changes: Food banks depend on donations and volunteers. Hours, food types and stock can change from week to week, and some events are cancelled at short notice. We only show today's stock when the pantry itself has posted it.
about.contact: Always call or check the organization's website before you travel. They have the most up-to-date information, and they can tell you what to bring.
about.disclaimer: This site is provided for information only. We are not affiliated with the organizations listed and cannot guarantee that help will be available. If you have an emergency, call 911. For other help, you can call 211.
about.privacy1: There are no ads, trackers, or analytics on this site.
about.privacy2: If you use “Use my location”, your location is used only for that search in your browser and is never stored.
about.privacy3: You do not need an account. If you create one, we store only your email, password (hashed), language, saved places, and search preferences.
about.privacy4: Your language choice is remembered on this device only.
about.live: Approved pantry staff can post today's status (open, limited, out of food, closed) and what's on the shelf. Every post is labelled “Posted by the pantry” with the time, and it disappears on its own when it expires. We confirm each staff member with the pantry before they can post.
about.reportsInfo: Anyone can report a problem with a listing. Reports go to the pantry and to our reviewers; several similar reports send the listing back for review.
about.privacy5: Problem reports store only what you chose and wrote. No name, account or location is stored.
about.privacy6: AI features, when turned on, receive only the words you type. Your location and account are never sent.
about.labelReported: Imported from a public list (see Sources). A Lantern reviewer has not checked it yet — call before you go.
about.aiLead: Lantern uses Claude AI (by Anthropic) to make help easier to find and to keep listings up to date. AI never publishes anything on its own.
aiItems: Ask Lantern AI: describe what you need in your own words (any language) and it builds the search for you.
Finding resources: AI reads official pages and flyers and turns them into listings. Every name, address, hour and requirement must appear word-for-word in the source, or it is thrown away.
For pantries: paste a Facebook post or flyer and AI fills in today's status or event for staff to check and post.
For reviewers: AI suggests structured hours and requirements, and helps spot duplicate listings. A person approves every change.
about.aiSafety: Privacy: only the words you type (or public provider text) are sent to the AI. Never your location, name, or account.
